sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯《Dealbook》的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你会收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: The death of 25-year-old
sentences.zh: 25 岁青年

sentences.en: Ahmaud Arbery and my colleague Richard Fawcett's investigation into it.
sentences.zh: 艾莫德·阿伯里之死，以及我的同事理查德·福塞特的对此事的调查。

sentences.en: It's Monday, May 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 5 月 11 日，星期一。

sentences.en: Richard, how did you first hear about this story?
sentences.zh: 理查德，你是怎么第一次听说这个故事的？

sentences.en: I learned about this story in early April.
sentences.zh: 我是在 4 月初得知这个故事的。

sentences.en: I was up to my eyeballs in coronavirus coverage, along with my other colleagues in the National Desk.
sentences.zh: 我和国内新闻部的其他同事一样，当时正忙得焦头烂额地报道新冠疫情。

sentences.en: And on April 2nd, my colleague Kim Severson, the food writer for The Times here in Atlanta, and a dear friend of mine, sent me a very brief note.
sentences.zh: 4 月 2 日，我的同事金·塞弗森——《时报》驻亚特兰大的美食记者，也是我的挚友——给我发了一封非常简短的便条。

sentences.en: And it said, look, comma, you are busy, period.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，听着，逗号，你很忙，句号。

sentences.en: But this one's looking pretty troubling.
sentences.zh: 但这桩看起来挺让人不安的。

sentences.en: She included a link to a story in the Brunswick News down in Brunswick, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 她附上了一篇发表在佐治亚州不伦瑞克当地报纸《不伦瑞克新闻》上的报道链接。

sentences.en: And it looked to be a story of two armed white men who were chasing an unarmed Black man by the name of Ahmaud
sentences.zh: 这似乎是一个这样的故事：两个武装白人男子在社区里追逐一个名叫艾莫德的

sentences.en: Arbery through their neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 无辜黑人男子

sentences.en: And that that chase ended with a confrontation and with the
sentences.zh: 阿伯里，而这场追逐

sentences.en: Black man being killed.
sentences.zh: 以冲突和这名黑人男子被杀告终。

sentences.en: The local coverage also showed that one of the men who was involved in this chase was a former police officer on the county police force who'd also spent years as
sentences.zh: 当地的报道还显示，参与这场追逐的其中一人是县警察局的前警官，他也曾在大卫

sentences.en: an investigator in the district attorney's office.
sentences.zh: 检察官办公室担任多年调查员。

sentences.en: And although the shooting had occurred on February
sentences.zh: 尽管枪击案发生在 2 月

sentences.en: 23rd, here we are in April, and no one had been arrested for it.
sentences.zh: 23 日，但现在已经是 4 月了，居然没有人因此被捕。

sentences.en: It was very disturbing.
sentences.zh: 这非常令人不安。

sentences.en: And it seemed like there were a lot of unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎有很多未解之谜。

sentences.en: And it was, I really didn't know if I could answer them.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我真的不知道自己能不能解开这些谜团。

sentences.en: But I had to set it aside for a while just because we had this avalanche of news rolling in.
sentences.zh: 但我不得不先把这事放一放，因为我们有源源不断的新闻雪崩般涌来。

sentences.en: So 10 or 11 days after getting this initial email from Kim, I started filing a flurry of open records requests.
sentences.zh: 所以在收到金发来的最初邮件的大约 10 或 11 天后，我开始密集提交信息公开记录申请。

sentences.en: And I had a sense of what I was pretty sure I could get from this from covering previous controversial shootings in Georgia.
sentences.zh: 根据以往在佐治亚州报道争议性枪击案的经验，我大致知道自己肯定能弄到什么。

sentences.en: I knew that I should be able to get a copy of the incident report, which is this kind of brief summary that police file of what they saw when they arrived at the scene.
sentences.zh: 我知道我应该能拿到一份事件报告的复印件，这是警方对他们抵达现场时所见情况的一种简要总结。

sentences.en: I was pretty sure I could get the 911 call recordings, which I don't think anybody had asked for yet.
sentences.zh: 我相当确信我可以拿到 911 报警电话的录音，我觉得当时还没有人索要过这些。

sentences.en: And then there was this other really just last minute request that I filed.
sentences.zh: 然后还有另一个我提交的、非常临时的申请。

sentences.en: And I filed it with the county.
sentences.zh: 我是向县里提交的。

sentences.en: And it was really just kind of a phishing exposition that I filed what turned out to be
sentences.zh: 这其实只是我随手进行的一场“钓鱼式”摸底，结果却成了

sentences.en: the most important public records requeSt. And in that request, I asked for all of the emails to and from public officials from the day of the shooting up to mid-April.
sentences.zh: 最重要的公共记录申请。在那个请求中，我要求获取从枪击当天到 4 月中旬期间发给公职人员以及由他们发出的所有电子邮件。

sentences.en: So essentially, you're trying to figure out if people in power in this community in the hours after
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，你是在试图弄清楚这个社区里掌权的人在枪击发生后的几个小时内，

sentences.en: this shooting are doing what you might expect them to do, which is saying, oh, my God, did you hear about this?
sentences.zh: 是否在做你可能会期待他们做的事，也就是惊呼：天哪，你听说这事了吗？

sentences.en: What do we do?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: That kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的话。

sentences.en: Yeah, I thought maybe there would just be some chatter.
sentences.zh: 对，我以为可能只会有些闲聊。

sentences.en: They might have just been gossiping.
sentences.zh: 他们可能只是在八卦。

sentences.en: You know, there just might have been a kind of, you know, oh, my God, kinds of emails.
sentences.zh: 你知道，可能只是一些诸如“天哪”之类的邮件。

sentences.en: I didn't quite know what to expect that, but I think that was my first thought.
sentences.zh: 我不太清楚该期待什么，但我想那是我的第一反应。

sentences.en: So under Georgia law, all of those entities have three days to respond to my requeSt. And of course, in an ongoing homicide
sentences.zh: 根据佐治亚州法律，所有这些机构都有三天的时间来回应我的请求。当然，在一起正在进行中的凶杀案

sentences.en: investigation, there are a lot of things they can say that they're not going to give me.
sentences.zh: 调查中，有很多东西他们是可以拒绝向我提供的。

sentences.en: So I talked to my editor and we decided that I would wake up super early, drive down to Glynn County,
sentences.zh: 所以我跟我的编辑谈了谈，我们决定我起个大早，开车前往佐治亚州的格林县，

sentences.en: Georgia, which is about four and a half or five hours from my home base in Atlanta to a neighborhood called Satilla Shores and do some social distancing reporting.
sentences.zh: 那里距离我位于亚特兰大的大本营大约有四个半或五个小时的车程，目的地是一个叫萨蒂拉海岸的社区，去进行一些保持社交距离的采访。

sentences.en: Satilla Shores is a middle-class neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 萨蒂拉海岸是一个中产阶级社区。

sentences.en: You know, ranch houses and a few nicer homes that look like retirement homes.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有牧场风格的平房，还有一些看起来像退休公寓的高档住宅。

sentences.en: It's kind of out of the way.
sentences.zh: 这里有点偏僻。

sentences.en: There's moss hanging from the oaks.
sentences.zh: 橡树上挂着西班牙苔藓。

sentences.en: I mean, it's dramatically beautiful and it kind of evokes Faulkner.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里美得惊艳，让人联想起威廉·福克纳的作品。

sentences.en: I mean, Faulkner with ranch houses, you know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，带有平房风格的福克纳，你知道的。

sentences.en: And Satilla Shores is in the unincorporated part of Glynn County.
sentences.zh: 萨蒂拉海岸位于格林县的非建制区。

sentences.en: Glynn County is a majority white place.
sentences.zh: 格林县是一个白人占多数的地方。

sentences.en: It's about 27% black.
sentences.zh: 黑人人口约占 27%。

sentences.en: And like almost every part of the South, it has a very tragic and kind of awful racial history, history of lynchings of black men in the late 19th century.
sentences.zh: 和南方几乎所有地方一样，这里有着非常悲惨且可怕的种族历史，19 世纪末曾发生过针对黑人男子的私刑历史。

sentences.en: So I pulled up and parked my car near the McMichaels home.
sentences.zh: 所以我把车开过来，停在了麦迈克尔家附近。

sentences.en: This is the home of the two men who chased Ahmad.
sentences.zh: 这是追逐艾莫德的那两名男子住所。

sentences.en: And almost as soon as I parked, a woman came out and she started asking me what I was doing there.
sentences.zh: 我刚把车停好，一个女人就出来了，开始盘问我在那里做什么。

sentences.en: And I told her, she told me she'd called the police on me and she told me she was armed.
sentences.zh: 我告诉了她，她告诉我她已经报警了，还说她有武器。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You know, I think there was just a lot of tension in the neighborhood and people were suspicious of my presence there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得社区里弥漫着紧张的气氛，人们对我的出现心存疑虑。

sentences.en: One very angry woman drove up to me as I was just walking the street and asked me repeatedly what I was doing there in a pretty hostile way.
sentences.zh: 当我正走在街上时，一个非常生气的女人开车冲到我旁边，用相当敌对的语气反复质问我在那儿干什么。

sentences.en: I came across another couple and they had already made up their mind that Ahmaud Arbery deserved what he had gotten.
sentences.zh: 我还遇到另外一对夫妇，他们已经认定艾莫德·阿伯里罪有应得。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So on Thursday night, I drove back to Atlanta and on Friday morning, I received the response to this last public records request that I had filed.
sentences.zh: 所以在周四晚上，我开车返回亚特兰大，周五早上，我收到了对我之前提交的最后一项公共记录请求的回复。

sentences.en: And Michael, as you know, you know, a lot of times those kinds of public records requests just bring back just a bunch of dross, you know, just garbage.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，如你所知，很多时候这类公共记录请求只能反馈回一堆废话，你知道的，就是垃圾。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But in this case, when I opened this fat email attachment, I knew immediately that I had found something pretty explosive.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，当我打开这封厚厚的带附件的电子邮件时，我立刻知道我发现了一些相当具有爆炸性的东西。

sentences.en: What was that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: So the first document in this file was a three-page memo written by a district attorney in Waycross, Georgia named George Barnhill, who at the time was the prosecutor in the case.
sentences.zh: 所以这份文件里的第一份是一个三页的备忘录，由佐治亚州韦克罗斯的一名地方检察官乔治·巴恩希尔撰写，他当时是该案的检察官。

sentences.en: And the prosecutor in a case like this often advises the local police as to whether or not there's sufficient probable cause to go to a judge and ask for an arrest warrant.
sentences.zh: 像这样的案件中的检察官通常会向当地警方提供咨询，评估是否有足够的客观合理根据去找法官申请逮捕令。

sentences.en: Mr. Barnhill in this letter laid out an extensive justification, legal justification for why he believed there was not sufficient probable cause
sentences.zh: 巴恩希尔先生在这封信中详细阐述了他认为为什么没有足够客观合理根据

sentences.en: to issue any arrest warrants for anyone.
sentences.zh: 对任何人发出逮捕令的广泛法律依据。

sentences.en: And his argument was that Mr. Arbery had committed a burglary and that the men who pursued him were justified in pursuing him under Georgia's citizen arrest law.
sentences.zh: 他的论点是，阿伯里先生犯下了入室盗窃罪，追逐他的人根据佐治亚州的公民逮捕法进行追逐是正当的。

sentences.en: It's said that the man who shot Ahmaud Arbery, Travis McMichael, was justified in doing so because Mr. Arbery had grabbed the shotgun.
sentences.zh: 信中称，开枪打死艾莫德·阿伯里的特拉维斯·麦迈克尔这样做是正当的，因为阿伯里先生抢夺了猎枪。

sentences.en: He had initiated a fight and Travis McMichael was allowed to use deadly force to protect himself under Georgia's use of force statute.
sentences.zh: 他挑起了冲突，根据佐治亚州的武力使用法规，特拉维斯·麦迈克尔被允许使用致命武力来保护自己。

sentences.en: And it said, of course, that the men were legally armed under Georgia's open carry law.
sentences.zh: 信中当然还指出，根据佐治亚州的公开携枪法，这些人是合法携带武器的。

sentences.en: But there were a lot of pieces of this that I knew a lot of lawyers and even other prosecutors were very likely going to take issue with.
sentences.zh: 但我知道，这其中有很多部分会让许多律师甚至其他检察官极力反对。

sentences.en: So in this prosecutor's telling, everything that these two men did in this interaction that resulted in Arbery's death, despite the fact that he was unarmed, was completely legal.
sentences.zh: 所以在这位检察官的叙述中，尽管阿伯里没有武器，这两名男子在导致阿伯里死亡的这次互动中所做的一切，完全都是合法的。

sentences.en: They were allowed to carry the guns.
sentences.zh: 他们被允许携带枪支。

sentences.en: They were allowed to make a citizen's arreSt. They were allowed, in his telling, to defend themselves from this unarmed man.
sentences.zh: 他们被允许实施公民逮捕。按照他的说法，他们被允许防卫自己，免受这个手无寸铁的男子的伤害。

sentences.en: In Mr. Barnhill's words, it was his conclusion there was insufficient probable cause to issue arrest warrants at the time.
sentences.zh: 用巴恩希尔先生的话说，他的结论是，当时没有足够的客观合理根据来签发逮捕令。

sentences.en: And in your mind, what makes this so explosive?
sentences.zh: 在你看来，是什么让这件事如此具有爆炸性？

sentences.en: I mean, what's explosive here is that you have this well-detailed legal justification
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里最具爆炸性的是，你竟然为一种行为找到了如此详尽的法律辩护，

sentences.en: for an action that I knew many people would see as one that just kind of violates their basic sense of what's right.
sentences.zh: 而我深知，在许多人看来，这种行为简直违背了他们对是非曲直的基本认知。

sentences.en: You had two armed white men in a truck chasing after an unarmed black man in a suburb in the Deep South.
sentences.zh: 深南部的某处郊区，两名携带武器的白人男子坐在一辆卡车里，追逐着一个手无寸铁的黑人男子。

sentences.en: There's a confrontation.
sentences.zh: 双方发生了冲突。

sentences.en: The black man is shot and killed.
sentences.zh: 黑人男子遭枪击身亡。

sentences.en: And no one has been arrested.
sentences.zh: 而没有人被捕。

sentences.en: And there's an argument now, a legal argument, that no one should be arrested.
sentences.zh: 现在甚至出现了一种法律论点，认为不应该逮捕任何人。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So I reported my story about this case, and I included this information about this district attorney who gave this legal justification for why no one should be arrested.
sentences.zh: 于是我报道了这起案件，并在报道中包含了关于这位地方检察官的信息，他为为什么不应逮捕任何人提供了法律辩护。

sentences.en: It also included the fact that, by that point, that district attorney had recused himself for a conflict
sentences.zh: 其中还包括这样一个事实：到那时为止，这位地方检察官已经因利益冲突

sentences.en: of intereSt. It turns out that his son worked in the local district attorney's office with Greg
sentences.zh: 而回避了此案。原来他的儿子在当地地方检察官办公室工作，同事正是格雷格

sentences.en: McMichael, one of the men who had pursued Ahmaud Arbery.
sentences.zh: 麦迈克尔——追逐过艾莫德·阿伯里的其中一人。

sentences.en: And the reaction to this story was pretty strong.
sentences.zh: 这个故事引发的反响非常强烈。

sentences.en: But we were also in the midst of a pandemic, and we were social distancing, and the country was locked down.
sentences.zh: 但我们也正处于大流行期间，我们都在保持社交距离，全国处于封锁状态。

sentences.en: And so the kinds of protests that we've seen crop up in big cities and other places when issues like this come to light were not materializing.
sentences.zh: 因此，每当此类事件曝光时，我们在大城市和其他地方看到的那种抗议活动并没有出现。

sentences.en: And so it was sort of unclear, really, where this whole drama was headed.
sentences.zh: 所以整个事件的发展方向实际上并不明朗。

sentences.en: But then on Tuesday, a video emerged online.
sentences.zh: 但到了周二，网络上出现了一段视频。

sentences.en: It was a 36-second video, and it showed the last violent moments of Ahmaud Arbery's life.
sentences.zh: 那是一段 36 秒的视频，记录了艾莫德·阿伯里生命中最后的暴力时刻。

sentences.en: And that started to change everything.
sentences.zh: 这开始改变一切。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订户每天都能获取到什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订户，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，即可获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Richard, what exactly does this video show?
sentences.zh: 理查德，这段视频究竟展示了什么？

sentences.en: The video appears to be shot from a moving car, and it shows a man running, presumably Ahmaud Arbery.
